mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.2 percentage points in one month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not rise by >0.2pp in a month, or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not increase in the same month, or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle expansion, or FEDFUNDS does not decline, or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5 percentage points in one month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% in a month, or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and employment (PAYEMS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either UNRATE or PAYEMS does not increase in the same month, or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and demand (GDPC1) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS or GDPC1 does not increase in the same month, or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not post-shock recovery, or FEDFUNDS does not decline, or 20-day returns are not positive.
